description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarSyncJobFactory class responsible for creating and managing scheduler jobs related to calendar synchronization, including account-specific and meeting synchronization jobs. It interacts with job queueing systems and calendar domain services.

classes.name: CalendarSyncJobFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing scheduler jobs related to calendar synchronization, including account and meeting jobs. It interacts with job queue systems, and calendar domain services, and manages scheduler retrieval.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Retrieves the scheduler instance that matches specific job conditions, with error handling.

methods.name: createAccountJob
methods.description: Creates and submits a job for a specific calendar account.

methods.name: createMeetingJob
methods.description: Creates a meeting synchronization job based on a CalendarSyncOperation object.

methods.name: createBaseJob
methods.description: Creates a base scheduler job with default properties.

methods.name: submitJob
methods.description: Submits a job to the job queue and returns its ID if successful.
